Enum.name: SpecOrientation
Enum.doc: Mirror of the WPF layout orientation.

Value.name: Horizontal
Value.doc: Children are stacked left to right.

Value.name: Vertical
Value.doc: Children are stacked top to bottom.

Enum.name: SpecTextWrapping
Enum.doc: Mirror of the WPF text wrapping mode.

Value.name: WrapWithOverflow
Value.doc: Wraps text, letting an unbreakable run overflow the line.

Value.name: NoWrap
Value.doc: No wrapping; text is clipped or trimmed on one line.

Value.name: Wrap
Value.doc: Wraps text, breaking mid-word when necessary.

Enum.name: SpecTypography
Enum.doc: Mirror of the Fluence type ramp applied to text blocks.

Value.name: None
Value.doc: No ramp style; inherit the ambient text style.

Enum.name: SpecInfoBarSeverity
Enum.doc: Mirror of the InfoBar severity, driving its glyph and color.

Enum.name: SpecSpinButtonPlacementMode
Enum.doc: Mirror of the NumberBox spin-button placement.

Value.name: Compact
Value.doc: Spin buttons appear in a compact flyout while focused.

Value.name: Inline
Value.doc: Spin buttons are always visible inline.

Enum.name: SpecStretch
Enum.doc: Mirror of the WPF stretch mode controlling how an image fills its space.

Value.name: None
Value.doc: The image keeps its natural size.

Value.name: Fill
Value.doc: The image fills the space, ignoring aspect ratio.

Value.name: Uniform
Value.doc: The image scales to fit, preserving aspect ratio.

Value.name: UniformToFill
Value.doc: The image scales to fill, preserving aspect ratio and clipping overflow.

Control.name: TextBlock
Control.doc: A themed text block for labels, messages, and headings.

Member.name: Text
Member.doc: The text to display.

Member.name: TextWrapping
Member.doc: How the text wraps; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Typography
Member.doc: The Fluence type-ramp style; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: TextBox
Control.doc: A themed single-line or multi-line text input.

Member.name: Text
Member.doc: The initial text; the live text is harvested into the result.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while the box is empty.

Member.name: HelperText
Member.doc: Persistent helper text shown under the box.

Member.name: ClearButtonEnabled
Member.doc: Whether the inline clear button is shown; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: AcceptsReturn
Member.doc: Whether Enter inserts a newline (multi-line editing); unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: MinLines
Member.doc: The minimum visible line count for multi-line editing; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: TextWrapping
Member.doc: How typed text wraps; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: MaxLength
Member.doc: The maximum number of characters accepted; unset means unlimited.

Control.name: PasswordBox
Control.doc: A themed masked password input; the value is read once when the dialog commits.

Member.name: Password
Member.doc: The initial password; the live value is harvested at commit time.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while the box is empty.

Member.name: MaxLength
Member.doc: The maximum number of characters accepted; unset means unlimited.

Member.name: RevealButtonEnabled
Member.doc: Whether the reveal (eye) button is shown; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: NumberBox
Control.doc: A themed numeric input with optional spin buttons. Its default value is 0, not null.

Member.name: Value
Member.doc: The initial numeric value; the live value is harvested into the result.

Member.name: Minimum
Member.doc: The inclusive minimum the control clamps to; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Maximum
Member.doc: The inclusive maximum the control clamps to; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: SmallChange
Member.doc: The spin/arrow-key step; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Header
Member.doc: A label rendered above the input.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while the box is empty.

Member.name: Description
Member.doc: Secondary descriptive text rendered with the input.

Member.name: SpinButtonPlacementMode
Member.doc: Where the spin buttons appear; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: CheckBox
Control.doc: A themed check box. An untouched box harvests false, not null.

Member.name: Content
Member.doc: The label text beside the box.

Member.name: Description
Member.doc: Secondary descriptive text under the label.

Member.name: IsChecked
Member.doc: The initial checked state; the live state is harvested into the result.

Control.name: ToggleSwitch
Control.doc: A themed on/off switch. An untouched switch harvests false, not null.

Member.name: IsChecked
Member.doc: The initial on/off state; the live state is harvested into the result.

Member.name: OnContent
Member.doc: The label shown while the switch is on.

Member.name: OffContent
Member.doc: The label shown while the switch is off.

Member.name: HeaderContent
Member.doc: A label rendered above the switch.

Control.name: ComboBox
Control.doc: A themed drop-down list of string choices.

Member.name: Items
Member.doc: The selectable choices, in order.

Member.name: SelectedItem
Member.doc: The initially selected choice; the live selection is harvested into the result.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while nothing is selected.

Control.name: RadioButton
Control.doc: A themed radio button. Radios sharing a GroupName form one choice; the checked radio's Content is harvested under the GroupName key.

Member.name: Content
Member.doc: The label text beside the radio; the harvested value when this radio is checked.

Member.name: GroupName
Member.doc: The mutual-exclusion group and the result key for the checked radio's Content.

Member.name: IsChecked
Member.doc: The initial checked state.

Member.name: Description
Member.doc: Secondary descriptive text under the label.

Member.name: SelectedDate
Member.doc: The initially selected date; the live selection is harvested into the result.

Member.name: Header
Member.doc: A label rendered above the picker.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while no date is selected.

Member.name: MinYear
Member.doc: The earliest selectable year; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: MaxYear
Member.doc: The latest selectable year; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: SelectedTime
Member.doc: The initially selected time of day; the live selection is harvested into the result.

Member.name: Header
Member.doc: A label rendered above the picker.

Member.name: PlaceholderText
Member.doc: Hint text shown while no time is selected.

Member.name: MinuteIncrement
Member.doc: The minute step of the minute column; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: ClockIdentifier
Member.doc: The clock system, '12HourClock' or '24HourClock'; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: HyperlinkButton
Control.doc: A themed hyperlink that opens a URI; it harvests no value.

Member.name: Content
Member.doc: The link text.

Member.name: NavigateUri
Member.doc: The absolute or relative URI the link opens.

Control.name: InfoBar
Control.doc: A themed inline notification bar for status messaging.

Member.name: Title
Member.doc: The bold title text.

Member.name: Message
Member.doc: The message body text.

Member.name: Severity
Member.doc: The severity driving glyph and color; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: IsOpen
Member.doc: Whether the bar is visible; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: IsClosable
Member.doc: Whether the user can dismiss the bar; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: ProgressBar
Control.doc: A themed determinate or indeterminate progress bar.

Member.name: Value
Member.doc: The current progress value; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Minimum
Member.doc: The value range minimum; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Maximum
Member.doc: The value range maximum; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: IsIndeterminate
Member.doc: Whether the bar animates indeterminately; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: IsActive
Member.doc: Whether the ring is active and visible; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: IsIndeterminate
Member.doc: Whether the ring animates indeterminately; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Value
Member.doc: The current progress value for determinate mode; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Minimum
Member.doc: The value range minimum; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Maximum
Member.doc: The value range maximum; unset keeps the control default.

Control.name: StackPanel
Control.doc: A themed stack layout container for composing child elements.

Member.name: Orientation
Member.doc: The stacking direction; unset keeps the control default (vertical).

Member.name: Spacing
Member.doc: Uniform spacing between children in device-independent pixels; unset keeps the control default.

Member.name: Children
Member.doc: The child elements, rendered in order.

Control.name: Border
Control.doc: A themed border container wrapping a single child element.

Member.name: Child
Member.doc: The single child element the border wraps.

Member.name: Padding
Member.doc: Inner padding as a WPF thickness string ('8' or '8,4' or '8,4,8,4').

Control.name: Image
Control.doc: A themed image presenter with a theme-aware stroke and rounded-corner clipping, for branding banners and logos.

Member.name: Source
Member.doc: The image file path or pack URI; the bitmap is loaded and frozen when the dialog materializes, and a missing file fails with the resolved path.

Member.name: SourceBase64
Member.doc: The image as raw bytes (a byte array auto-encodes to Base64). Applies after Source, so when both are set the bytes win.

Member.name: Stretch
Member.doc: How the image fills its space; unset keeps the control default (Uniform).

Member.name: CornerRadius
Member.doc: The frame corner radius as '8' or 'topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft'; unset keeps the themed default.
